title: Autonomous Model Lifecycle Management for Digital Twin-Based Manufacturing Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.22701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manufacturing AI systems must autonomously adapt to continuous distributional shift from raw-material variability, ambient changes, and equipment aging, under strict safeguard and operator-trust requirements where model failures risk physical damage. This paper presents a closed-loop Cyber-Physical System (CPS) for autonomous model lifecycle management in automotive manufacturing, deployed since 2023. The system manages product-specialized model pairs: a sequence-to-sequence physics model (LPP) serving as a digital twin, and a deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy (LCP) trained against it. Per retraining cycle, multiple model variants spanning architecture families and RL algorithms compete; only the best-scoring candidate advances. A Conductor orchestrator autonomously manages plant-wide model inventories with dependency-aware retraining and Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) fallback. Reflecting the principle of Human-Cen

translated_title: 面向基于数字孪生的制造控制的自主模型生命周期管理
translated_abstract: 制造业AI系统必须在严格的安全保障和操作员信任要求下，自主适应由原材料变异性、环境变化和设备老化引起的持续分布漂移，因为模型故障可能带来物理损害风险。本文提出了一个用于汽车制造中自主模型生命周期管理的闭环信息物理系统（CPS），该系统自2023年起已实际部署。该系统管理产品专用的模型对：一个作为数字孪生的序列到序列物理模型（LPP），以及一个针对该模型训练的深度强化学习（RL）控制策略（LCP）。在每个再训练周期中，跨越不同架构族和RL算法的多个模型变体相互竞争，只有得分最高的候选模型才能晋级。一个名为Conductor的编排器通过依赖感知的再训练和比例-积分-微分（PID）回退机制，自主管理全厂范围的模型库存。体现以人为中（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了一个自2023年起部署于汽车制造的闭环信息物理系统，通过数字孪生物理模型与深度强化学习控制策略组成的模型对、多候选模型竞争机制以及具备依赖感知再训练和PID回退能力的自主编排器，实现了制造AI模型的自主生命周期管理。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a closed-loop Cyber-Physical System deployed in automotive manufacturing since 2023, which achieves autonomous model lifecycle management through product-specialized digital twin/RL policy pairs, competitive multi-variant model selection, and a Conductor orchestrator with dependency-aware retraining and PID fallback.
